title: Certify QF_UF refutations from the legacy proof object in Lean
summary: The exporter now accepts QF_UF input from the legacy core's proof object, and the Lean reconstructor turns its equality, congruence, if-then-else, distinct, and commutativity steps into explicit Lean proof terms. All documented inputs, 109 random instances, and a 1,230-step equality diamond are kernel-checked under the standard axioms, with no C++ changes.
